BiblicalUsage: Beninu means "our son." He was a returning Levite exile who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah. You will find it in Nehemiah 10:13.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Beninu is worth remembering, even when little else is told — God counts His people one by one.
